evidence.observation: For a fully ordered exact M4 the credits are (1, 1/3, -1/3, -1), whose mean is exactly zero.
The public candidate test explicitly confirms the zero-sum M4 while preserving correct Actor directions.
The active state-value Critic consumes a current-M4 scalar mean, which cannot be reused as relational repair quality here.
